features.definition: Pokémon primarily moves or stands on two limbs (bipedal). 1 = clearly bipedal, 0 = quadrupedal, limbless, or floats/swims.
Pokémon primarily moves on four limbs. 1 = clearly quadrupedal, 0 = otherwise.
Pokémon is based on an aquatic animal or has strong water/ocean body features (fins, flippers, gills, water bubble, aquatic shape). 1 = strongly aquatic, 0 = not aquatic.
Pokémon is bird-like with wings, feathers, beak. 1 = clearly avian, 0 = not avian.
Pokémon resembles a reptile, dinosaur, or dragon. 1 = clearly reptilian/dragon, 0 = not.
Pokémon resembles a real-world mammal (canine, feline, primate, pinniped, marsupial, mongoose, etc.). 1 = clearly mammalian, 0 = not.
Pokémon resembles an insect, arachnid, or other arthropod. 1 = clearly insect/bug/arachnid, 0 = not.
Pokémon is primarily plant-based or has significant plant body features (leaves, vines, flowers, roots as limbs). 1 = plant-based, 0 = not.
Pokémon appears robotic, mechanical, or made of metal with artificial construction. 1 = robotic/mechanical, 0 = organic-looking.
Pokémon has a ghostly, spectral, or clearly supernatural/non-physical body (floating without wings, spirit-like form, etc.). 1 = ghostly/supernatural, 0 = not.
Blue is the most prominent or dominant color covering the majority of the Pokémon's body. 1 = predominantly blue, 0 = not.
Brown or tan is the most prominent color covering the majority of the body. 1 = predominantly brown/tan, 0 = not.
Green is the most prominent color. 1 = predominantly green, 0 = not.
Pokémon has wings or fin-like structures capable of or used for flight/gliding. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
Pokémon has a clearly described tail. 1 = yes, 0 = no visible tail.
Pokémon has at least one horn or spike projecting from its head. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
Pokémon has a humanoid body shape (upright torso, two arms, two legs, recognizable head). Score 1 = strongly humanoid, 0 = not humanoid.
Description implies a large Pokémon (uses words like 'large', 'massive', 'big', or describes large features proportionally). 1 = large, 0 = small or medium.
Pokémon has more than one face or head described. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
Pokémon is described as frog-like or has explicit frog features (webbed feet, frog body shape, tongue wrapping). 1 = frog-like, 0 = not.
Pokémon has crystals, gems, or jewels embedded in or on its body. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
Pokémon has a notable spotted or striped body pattern. 1 = yes, 0 = no such pattern.
Pokémon has a notably long, elongated, or serpentine body shape. 1 = yes, 0 = not.
Pokémon has antennae, antenna-like growths, or other specialized sensory appendages on its head. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
Description mentions unique legendary/mythical traits (genie, cloud body, only-male/female species, special lore). 1 = yes, 0 = no such cues.
Pokémon has claws described on its limbs. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
Pokémon has fire-related features or a predominantly orange/red/flame color scheme. 1 = yes, 0 = no.
How compact/round the Pokémon body is. 1 = very compact/round, 0 = very elongated/tall/spread out.
Yellow or gold is the most prominent color covering the majority of the Pokémon's body. 1 = predominantly yellow/gold, 0 = not.
Purple or pink is the most prominent color covering the majority of the Pokémon's body. 1 = predominantly purple/pink, 0 = not.
White or gray is the most prominent color covering the majority of the Pokémon's body. 1 = predominantly white/gray, 0 = not.
